name: Chickie JoeJoe
desc: Protagonist of the beloved fairy tale JoeJoe's Bizarre Adventure, famed across the continent of Atlasia. Each day, this plucky chickie named JoeJoe awakens in a new land, befriends interesting characters, and embarks on bizarre quests to discover the meaning of life and thwart villainy wherever it stirs.
